metadata.decision: Rejected as a general import improvement. The favorable screen did not replicate across independently provisioned confirmation hosts; all observations and controls retained.
metadata.diagnosticRetention: The exact VNDB trace JSON, raw report and summary are reintroduced byte-identically under diagnostics/vndb as explicit fileInputs. Their original candidate-trace ZIP paths are disclosed as omitted; rendered HTML is omitted entirely. This separate traced run is excluded from every timing estimate.
limitations: Sampled public lookup/media checks and restart checks, not exhaustive stored-byte equivalence.
The original ZIP containers are not embedded; their exact sizes, SHA256 digests, public IDs and all retained member bytes are preserved.
metadata.localValidation: Original fixed16 validation receipts and logs retained, including compiler-configuration failures and Android helper timeouts. These are validation evidence, not benchmark timings.
metadata.sourceSnapshotPolicy: Only frozen Git commit blobs; no live adaptive production source, tests, receipts, or timings included.
metadata.timingInterpretation: Screen and confirmation remain separate. Each corpus and independent replication remains separate. No pooled host estimates, tail exclusions, retries to improve results, or control subtraction.
metadata.title: Fixed 16 MiB import-index checkpoint screen and rejected general confirmation
